using Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Input;

namespace XnaReborn.Compat.Device
{
    public static class DeviceControls
    {
        /// <summary>Tilt in g on X and Y while a direction key is held.</summary>
        public static readonly float TiltFull = 0.7f;

        /// <summary>Time constant, in seconds, of the easing between readings.</summary>
        public static readonly float EaseSeconds = 0.12f;

        /// <summary>Resting reading: the device lying face up.</summary>
        public static readonly float RestingX = 0.0f;
        public static readonly float RestingY = 0.0f;
        public static readonly float RestingZ = -1.0f;

        /// <summary>Default time between accelerometer readings.</summary>
        public static readonly double UpdateMilliseconds = 20.0;

        /// <summary>True to tilt with the mouse offset from the window centre instead of the keys.</summary>
        public static readonly bool UseMouseTilt = false;

        /// <summary>True to let a web browser task open http and https links.</summary>
        public static readonly bool OpenWebLinks = false;

        /// <summary>Left stick and D-pad left, tilt left.</summary>
        public static readonly Keys[] MoveLeft = { Keys.Left, Keys.A };

        /// <summary>Left stick and D-pad right, tilt right.</summary>
        public static readonly Keys[] MoveRight = { Keys.Right, Keys.D };

        /// <summary>Left stick and D-pad up, tilt up (top edge down).</summary>
        public static readonly Keys[] MoveUp = { Keys.Up, Keys.W };

        /// <summary>Left stick and D-pad down, tilt down (top edge up).</summary>
        public static readonly Keys[] MoveDown = { Keys.Down, Keys.S };

        /// <summary>A button.</summary>
        public static readonly Keys[] ButtonA = { Keys.Space, Keys.Enter };

        /// <summary>B button.</summary>
        public static readonly Keys[] ButtonB = { Keys.Z };

        /// <summary>X button.</summary>
        public static readonly Keys[] ButtonX = { Keys.X };

        /// <summary>Y button.</summary>
        public static readonly Keys[] ButtonY = { Keys.C };

        /// <summary>Back button (the phone's hardware Back button).</summary>
        public static readonly Keys[] Back = { Keys.Escape };

        /// <summary>Start button.</summary>
        public static readonly Keys[] Start = { Keys.Tab };

        /// <summary>Left shoulder button.</summary>
        public static readonly Keys[] LeftShoulder = { Keys.Q };

        /// <summary>Right shoulder button.</summary>
        public static readonly Keys[] RightShoulder = { Keys.E };
    }
